goal: positions_for replays entries and retractions. Event IDs are globally idempotent. A retraction cancels its referenced posting exactly once, even if it arrives before that posting. Unmatched retractions have no balance effect; accounts whose entries cancel retain a zero entry. Inspect the code, repair the implementation, and run the tests. Do not modify tests.
